provenance: Fresh full-book narrative and exact-source-selection comparison after explicit-frame/eager-GC backport and Functions soundness proofs. Rechecked the prior unit-specific reasoning against current raw units, selected declarations/tests, dependencies and review policy; corrected obsolete pre-exit/completion descriptions. rationale: Comparison for unit:meta.syntax.inline_and_block against rust:mdbook-dada/src/units.rs:parse_block, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:directive_blocks, rust:mdbook-dada/src/lib.rs:render, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:block_directives_are_distinct_from_literal_code_and_inline_roles, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:informational_paragraphs_preserve_markdown_and_literal_examples, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:generated_grammar_directives_require_migration, test:mdbook-dada/tests/book.rs:inferred_judgment_and_rule_directives_require_migration, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:drafts_keep_their_semantic_kind_without_claiming_a_formalization, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:draft_status_is_explicit_and_does_not_relax_citation_checks, test:mdbook-dada/tests/units.rs:removed_obligation_syntax_is_rejected_at_every_authoring_entry_point. directive_blocks distinguishes brace-prefixed supported fences from ordinary language fences; parse_block retains semantic kind under draft status while still checking supplied citations; render rejects legacy inferred forms and paragraph examples. Tests cover literals, informational Markdown, old syntax diagnostics, draft forms and removed obligations at all entry points. The closed-body dependency supplies the structured nesting boundary. Notation and judgment context was checked in unit:meta.units.closed_body.
limitations: Author self-review, not an independent review.

Implementation/test inspection is correspondence evidence; actual command results are recorded separately. Tests do not prove universal behavior, browser appearance, CDN availability, or authenticated execution.
